# How to Create a Client Workspace and Welcome Pack When a Stripe Subscription Starts

When a new Stripe subscription begins, verify the event by signature, then fan out in parallel to provision a Monday.com client board, post an internal Slack kickoff, and call a reusable welcome-pack subworkflow that emails onboarding materials through Resend.

## What This Integration Does

For a professional-services firm, every new retainer or subscription kicks off the same scramble: someone has to spin up a project board, tell the team in chat, and send the client their onboarding pack. This Spojit workflow does all three the moment a customer's Stripe subscription goes live, so a signed deal turns into a ready-to-work client space within seconds and nothing slips through the cracks.

Stripe posts a`customer.subscription.created` event to your workflow's Webhook trigger URL. Spojit verifies the request signature against your Stripe signing secret, parses the JSON body, and immediately returns`202` with an`executionId` so Stripe sees a fast acknowledgement. A Parallel node then runs three independent branches at once: a Monday.com board provisioning branch, a Slack kickoff-message branch, and a Subworkflow branch that calls your shared welcome-pack workflow. ## README

# Stripe New Customer → Full Onboarding Pipeline

A turnkey n8n workflow that fires the moment someone subscribes in Stripe. Sends a welcome email, books them onto your onboarding call, logs to your CRM, and tells your team — all in 4 seconds, no human involved.

> Part of my Fiverr gig series — demo workflows that show what I build.
> Need this wired into YOUR Stripe account? → Order on Fiverr

---

## What it does

```
Stripe Webhook
(customer.subscription.created)
      │
      ├─────▶ Welcome Email (personalized: plan, name, onboarding link)
      │
      ├─────▶ Notion CRM: create customer record
      │
      ├─────▶ Slack #new-customers: "🎉 @jane signed up on Pro ($75/mo)"
      │
      └─────▶ Calendly: send kickoff-call scheduler link
```

When a subscription is created in Stripe, all four branches run in parallel. No delay between signup and follow-up. No chance of your team forgetting about a new paying customer because they were at lunch.

## Why this workflow is worth money

The gap between "Stripe charged the card" and "customer feels cared for" is where most SaaS loses churn. This closes it.
